description: One of a rule's five filters: the set of names it matches, and whether the limit is shared or per name.

attributes.name: expand
description: False means one limit shared by everything the filter matches; true means a separate limit for each matched name. This is what distinguishes "100 slots between all users" from "100 slots each".

attributes.name: scope
description: The names the filter matches (`ST`). A single `*` entry means everything.

attributes.name: xscope
description: Names explicitly excluded, applied after RQRF_scope.
